derivation.canonical_behavior: Go classifies resolved IPv4/IPv6 candidates and binds approval to explicit request/resource scope.

invariants: Public, private, loopback, link-local, reserved, multicast and unspecified routes are classified explicitly for IPv4 and IPv6.
IPv4-mapped IPv6 is classified using the embedded IPv4 address.
A mixed public/private DNS result requires approval for every non-public class.
Approval is bound to request ID, logical resource, exact target scope, origin and address class.
Primary approval is not reusable for mirrors or redirects.
